en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a quiet street lined with wooden buildings, identified as 'Kronogatan' in Vänersborg, Sweden. There are a couple of people seen walking on the cobblestone road. The reverse side includes a handwritten address in Swedish, a green Swedish stamp with a postmark dated 1905, and additional Swedish text in cursive on the image side itself.
